                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                signature TEXT NOT NULL, progress_refs TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id,operation_key))

schema.name: runtime_progress_exposures
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_progress_exposures (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_handle TEXT NOT NULL, operation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                signature TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id,target_handle,operation_key))

schema.name: runtime_progress_notifications
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_progress_notifications (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_handle TEXT NOT NULL, operation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                publication_ref TEXT NOT NULL, published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id,target_handle,operation_key), UNIQUE(run_id,publication_ref))

schema.name: runtime_progress_observations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_progress_observations (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, progress_ref TEXT NOT NULL, target_handle TEXT NOT NULL,
                scope TEXT NOT NULL, signature TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
                observation_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id,progress_ref), UNIQUE(run_id,target_handle,scope,signature))

schema.name: runtime_progress_receipts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_progress_receipts (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, progress_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                operation_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id,progress_ref))

schema.name: runtime_progress_selections
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_progress_selections (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation_key TEXT NOT NULL, signature TEXT NOT NULL,
                selection TEXT NOT NULL, progress_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id,operation_key))

schema.name: runtime_receipt_inheritance
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_receipt_inheritance(
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                parent_episode_id TEXT, through_receipt_index INTEGER,
                received_report_prefix TEXT,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id))

schema.name: runtime_record_receipts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_record_receipts(
                receipt_index INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                record_ref TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_index INTEGER,
                UNIQUE(run_id,episode_id,record_ref))

schema.name: runtime_report_attempts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_report_attempts (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          decision_index INTEGER NOT NULL, delivery_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
          child_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, contract TEXT NOT NULL,
          form TEXT, failure TEXT, timing_receipts TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(run_id,parent_episode_id,decision_index))

schema.name: runtime_runs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_runs (
          run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, settings TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL,
          summary TEXT, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: runtime_source_states
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_source_states (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_state TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id))

schema.name: runtime_timed_commissions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_timed_commissions (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
          selection_digest TEXT NOT NULL, child_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          scheduled_at REAL NOT NULL, due_at REAL NOT NULL, fired_at REAL, returned_at REAL,
          PRIMARY KEY(run_id,parent_episode_id,decision_index))

schema.name: tool_operations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE tool_operations (
            operation_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
            arguments TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL)

Supply one UTF-8 RNA feature input JSON with the original record key, optional labels/sequence, exact or uppercase_ascii normalization, structure, supplied origin and provenance, optional physical subject binding, and energy_mode. Nested .()[]{} is supported; crossing pairs are explicitly unsupported. No repair or partial pairing subset is inferred for invalid topology. Pair endpoints are zero-based nucleotide indices; unpaired intervals are half open. Retain every position, immediate nesting relationship, maximal stem and exposed hairpin, bulge, internal, multibranch and exterior region. Optional sequence permits RNA IUPAC; ambiguous pairs remain distinct and excluded from an explicitly unambiguous-pair denominator. An absent sequence is different from empty or length-mismatched sequence. energy_mode=none needs no ViennaRNA import and no model. energy_mode=viennarna_evaluate requires unambiguous ACGU, an explicit model and RNA.fold_compound(sequence, md).eval_structure(structure).
